
func BenchmarkLegacyScalarArray(b *testing.B) {
	const n = 128
	fs, cs := make([]float32, n), make([]complex64, n)
	for i := range fs {
		fs[i] = float32(i) + 0.5
		cs[i] = complex(fs[i], -fs[i])
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name string
		src  any
		dst  func() any
	}{
		{"Float32", &fs, func() any { return new([]float32) }},
		{"Complex64", &cs, func() any { return new([]complex64) }},
	} {
		b.Run(tc.name+"/Save", func(b *testing.B) {
			var buf bytes.Buffer
			for b.Loop() {
				buf.Reset()
				if _, err := state.Save(b.Context(), &buf, tc.src); err != nil {
					b.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
		})
		b.Run(tc.name+"/Load", func(b *testing.B) {
			var buf bytes.Buffer
			if _, err := state.Save(b.Context(), &buf, tc.src); err != nil {
				b.Fatal(err)
			}
			for b.Loop() {
				if _, err := state.Load(b.Context(), bytes.NewReader(buf.Bytes()), tc.dst()); err != nil {
					b.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
